cohort.selection: Ten active workflows selected for varied objectives and output types, excluding schema-feature-coverage. One recent completed run per workflow before the common cutoff; failures and no-ops were retained.
cohort.scope_limit: These empirical examples are all from github/gh-aw. This is not a real cross-repository trial or an estimate of workflow value.

method.collection: gh aw logs --stdin --repo github/gh-aw --adoption --count 1 --artifacts usage,delivery --output OUTPUT/native --json
method.report: gh aw value WORKFLOW --repo github/gh-aw --logs-dir OUTPUT/native --start 2026-11-01 --end 2026-11-17 --json
method.identity: Run IDs and source SHAs come from retained canonical sessions. Lifecycle classifications come from native gh-aw reporting, not pilot-specific rules.
method.candidate_contracts: Metric candidates below are design contracts, not executable value-function definitions. No unsupported evaluator or query syntax is declared.
method.side_effects: Read completed-run artifacts and provider state only; no workflow dispatch, Git history fetch, workflow-source edit, lifecycle fabrication, or retrospective grader mutation.

findings: The nine readable runs contain four verified effects: one human-accepted issue, one pending discussion, and two delivery-fallback effects on one triaged issue. These are not four units of value.
All ten value reports return measurement_not_configured and attributed_value null. None of the workflows has a reviewed committed numeric projection or a supported objective-specific evaluator.
All four retained effects are non-PR outputs. The current PR-only attribution rule cannot credit them, even though it preserves their native lifecycle evidence.

Six complete zero-delivery runs are visible as zero in logs but unavailable in value because the retained delivery ledger has no item records for them. Coverage needs a run-level representation; value must not infer zero from an absent ledger.
The failed CLI-performance run lacks canonical format/execution identity. Combined collection aborts on this error; independent per-workflow collection preserves the other nine outcomes.
Recorded built-in tool-success, duration, retry, and loop grades are not workflow-specific outcome measurements. No retained operational-value grader was found.
No-op and report_incomplete are distinct. Neither a no-op message nor a successful workflow conclusion independently proves correct restraint or attained value.
File Diet supplies a verified mechanical outcome witness, but issue-to-PR attribution is unsupported and its seven-day post-adoption window is incomplete.
The checkout is shallow. This pilot did not replay full historical merge windows, estimate causal effects, validate all proposed metrics, or demonstrate saved maintainer time.

priorities.reason: A fixed size policy and exact Git blobs already support an independently recomputable native-unit outcome.
Pinned successful whole-program analyzer output can support subject-level snapshot measurements, with protected/WASM cases handled explicitly.
The intended outcome has a native benchmark unit, but needs valid benchmark-series evidence rather than agent duration or a main-tree JSON assumption.

workflows.goal: Resolve confirmed documentation gaps missed by the regular updater.

metric_candidate.formula: Count distinct independently confirmed gap IDs whose required documentation correction is verified in accepted changes.

workflows.blocker: This pilot did not establish independent gap identities or a verified correction; a no-op is not proof of correct restraint.

metric_candidate.formula: Count eligible unreachable file:function identities reported by a pinned successful analyzer over both ./cmd/... and ./internal/tools/....

workflows.blocker: No reviewed committed projection is configured; this pilot did not establish an independently measured before/after removal outcome.

workflows.goal: Reduce test execution time without introducing unsafe parallelism.

metric_candidate.formula: Compare repeated fixed-suite elapsed-time measurements under the same runner, toolchain, test inventory, and concurrency settings.

workflows.blocker: The selected run is incomplete. Counting t.Parallel additions would reward activity, not independently verified speed or safety.

workflows.goal: Make important diagnostic scenarios observable through meaningful safe debug logging.

metric_candidate.formula: Count frozen diagnostic scenarios whose expected useful debug evidence is independently observed without side effects or sensitive output.

workflows.blocker: Logger imports, log-call counts, or files with logger.New do not establish useful diagnostics; no independent scenario inventory was established for this pilot.

workflows.goal: Identify oversized non-test Go source files and drive focused refactoring.

metric_candidate.formula: For tracked pkg/**/*.go files excluding *_test.go, sum max(0, newline_count(file) - 799).
metric_candidate.interpretation: Mechanical size-policy outcome, not code quality, removed LOC, runtime improvement, or saved time.

workflows.blocker: The current command cannot attribute an issue's downstream PR; the complete seven-day window is not yet available and no production measurement projection is configured.

metric_candidate.formula: Count required metric observations that agree with independent recomputation over a fixed metric/date/source scope.
requires: separate evidence of downstream decisions for longitudinal value
metric_candidate.interpretation: Potential run-scoped report-quality metric, not longitudinal value.

workflows.blocker: Publishing charts or a weighted quality score does not prove that the report improved code health; cache/repo-memory observations are not main-tree snapshot inputs.

workflows.goal: Correctly classify eligible unassigned, unlabeled issues.

metric_candidate.evidence_scope: recorded eligibility and independently reviewed object-state transitions
metric_candidate.formula: Count distinct eligible issue IDs whose applied allowed label matches an independent reference classification.
requires: retention observations when making durable-outcome claims

workflows.blocker: A label and comment are two effects on one issue, not two correctly triaged issues or human acceptances. Independent label correctness and full eligibility are missing.

workflows.goal: Reduce obsolete PR backlog without discarding genuine work.

metric_candidate.formula: Count distinct closed PRs independently verified to meet the complete staleness, exemption, authorship, and supersession policy.
requires: all exemption labels and activity clocks

workflows.blocker: Closure counts reward potentially harmful actions; this pilot did not establish independent complete eligibility proof for the no-op.

metric_candidate.formula: Compare repeated BenchmarkCompileSimpleWorkflow ns/op observations with fixed inputs, runner, toolchain, and measurement protocol.
metric_candidate.interpretation: Agent execution duration and tool-success grades are not compiler benchmark measurements.

observed.error: lifecycle session is missing its format or execution identity

workflows.blocker: The selected run has no canonical identity. Benchmark history lives in repo-memory, outside the current report's main-tree numeric-evidence scope.

workflows.goal: Complete validated dependency remediation with less maintainer coordination.

metric_candidate.evidence_scope: frozen update-batch and accepted repository-state evidence
metric_candidate.formula: Count distinct eligible manifest/package/target-version entries actually present in a validated, human-adopted change.
requires: exact target versions in accepted manifests and lockfiles
native human adoption and complete survival
metric_candidate.interpretation: Verified remediation outcome, not a claim about unmeasured maintainer time saved.

workflows.blocker: The run is incomplete; no validated adopted target state is available. PR-count reduction would not establish successful dependency remediation.
